items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Dave Grusin and I, that's where we met and became very close buddies

ctx.x: Yeah and you did some things for Andy Williams’ variety show right?

Oh yeah, in fact Dave Grusin and I, that's where we met and became very close buddies, we were on Andy’s show for a couple years. That was a fun show to do ‘cause you know it was live TV, we had a good band.
